prs.title: feat(invoice): late fees on overdue invoices
prs.body:
Overdue invoices now accrue a late fee, as agreed with finance.

## Changes

- `Invoice.LateFee`: 1.5% of the amount per started 30 days past the due date, capped at six periods
- `Invoice.AmountDue`: the amount plus the late fee
- `GET /invoices/{id}` returns `late_fee_cents` and `amount_due_cents`
- README: document late fees
prs.author: alice

prs.title: fix(api): reject unknown currency codes
prs.body:
`POST /invoices` stored whatever currency it was sent, including an empty one, and finance could not reconcile those invoices.

## Changes

- Add `invoice.ValidCurrency` (EUR, GBP, NOK, SEK, USD)
- `POST /invoices` trims and upper-cases the code and answers 422 for an unsupported one
- Handler test for valid, empty and unknown codes
prs.author: fredric
